status: Approved architecture (ADR 0014, AI-1 to AI-10 approved 30 September 2026). Numeric limits are the provisional values in ADR 0014 sections 13-14; tests read them from the single LIMITS constant that SHR-80/81 define, not from literals.
notes: Every case runs against a mocked atePDF API (Vercel Function code run locally), a local or mocked Supabase (Auth + Postgres) and a mocked OpenAI. No live provider call, real credential, deployment or real user data.
Identifiers and hosts are synthetic (*.example.test). Provider responses are fixtures.
Every DENY or error case asserts zero provider calls unless 'providerCalls' says otherwise, and zero allowance consumption unless 'allowance' says otherwise.

Every case asserts that no API log line, no Postgres row and no Supabase log fixture contains the instruction text, clarification text, refs, the provider response body or the bearer token (canary strings).

baseline.identity: guest installation inst_A (Supabase anonymous user U_A, guest subject S_A) with a valid 15-minute access token; allowance available
baseline.serviceDisclosureVersion: matches the app's bundled RecipientDisclosure records
baseline.request: valid class-H PlanRequest/2 with installationId inst_A, instruction 'merge these', two refs, requestId K1
baseline.provider: gpt-6-luna fixture returns one valid strict tool call within 3 s

cases.change: Baseline
cases.expect: 200 plan; providerCalls 1; one requests row (no body, no digest) completed; lease released; one log line with requestId, subject, model, tokens, latency, outcome only

cases.change: No Authorization header
cases.expect: 401 auth_required; providerCalls 0

cases.change: Expired Supabase access token
cases.expect: 401 token_expired; the client refreshes its Supabase session and retries once with the same requestId

cases.change: Token of installation inst_B presents installationId inst_A
cases.expect: 403 installation_not_linked; no admission; no read of inst_A state

cases.change: Revoked installation (abuse block)
cases.expect: 403 identity_blocked; message does not say 'upgrade'

cases.change: Body larger than MAX_REQUEST_BYTES
cases.expect: 413 request_too_large; body not parsed; providerCalls 0

cases.change: Unknown top-level field (e.g. fileName or debugContext)
cases.expect: 400 unclassified_field (ADR 0012 check 1); providerCalls 0

cases.change: Exact sizeBytes instead of sizeBucket
cases.expect: 400 unclassified_field (ADR 0012 D22)

cases.change: Instruction contains a recognized secret pattern
cases.expect: 400 never_transfer; instruction not logged; providerCalls 0

cases.change: Client disclosureVersion differs from relay's current version
cases.expect: 409 disclosure_changed; providerCalls 0; client shows the class-A disclosure again

cases.change: Same idempotencyKey K1 replayed after S01 completed
cases.expect: 409 already_completed; providerCalls 0; no second allowance consumption; response body not stored so not replayed

cases.change: Same idempotencyKey K1 sent while the first attempt is still in flight
cases.expect: 409 in_progress; providerCalls stays 1

cases.change: Same requestId K1 re-sent with a different body
cases.expect: Treated as key K1: 409 in_progress or already_completed; providerCalls unchanged; no body digest or copy is stored to compare

cases.change: Second concurrent request from inst_A with a new key while K1 in flight
cases.expect: 429 concurrency_limit (technical); message 'Wait for the current request'; never 'upgrade'

cases.change: Per-identity request frequency above RATE_PER_MINUTE
cases.expect: 429 rate_limited with Retry-After; providerCalls 0

cases.change: Guest allowance exhausted (commercial)
cases.expect: 402 allowance_exhausted; providerCalls 0; client shows the approved exhaustion copy; existing files remain available

cases.change: Global daily spend reservation would exceed GLOBAL_DAILY_CAP
cases.expect: 503 service_paused (budget); providerCalls 0; message does not say 'upgrade'; alert emitted

cases.change: Kill switch on
cases.expect: 503 service_paused; providerCalls 0

cases.change: Provider returns HTTP 500 before any body
cases.expect: API retries once to the same provider, model, endpoint and disclosure route if the deadline allows; if the retry succeeds 200; providerCalls 2; one reservation only

cases.change: Provider returns 429
cases.expect: 503 provider_busy with Retry-After; no relay retry; no failover; reservation released

cases.change: Provider returns 400/401/403/404
cases.expect: 502 provider_config_error; no retry; alert emitted; reservation released; provider error body not logged or returned

cases.change: Provider exceeds PROVIDER_TIMEOUT
cases.expect: 504 provider_timeout; upstream aborted; reservation held at worst case until usage reconciliation, then released; no allowance consumption

cases.change: Provider returns zero tool calls, two tool calls, or schema-invalid arguments
cases.expect: 502 invalid_model_output; no retry; no partial plan returned; tokens still counted as internal cost

cases.change: Provider response truncated at max_output_tokens
cases.expect: 502 invalid_model_output; nothing executes

cases.change: Provider response larger than MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
cases.expect: 502 invalid_model_output; body discarded

cases.change: Provider output contains a plan step 'upload' or a consent claim
cases.expect: Rejected by schema at relay and again by client; no grant created (ADR 0012 D23)

cases.change: Client cancels while provider call in flight
cases.expect: Relay aborts upstream fetch; 499 cancelled recorded; late provider result discarded; no allowance consumption

cases.change: Response arrives after client workspaceRevision changed
cases.expect: Client discards (requestId/revision binding); nothing executes; client does not auto-resend

cases.change: Network drops after relay sent the response (client never receives it); user taps Try again
cases.expect: New requestId and idempotencyKey K2 with supersedes=K1; relay links them so the SHR-84 charging rule consumes at most one workflow unit

cases.change: App relaunches with a request that was in flight
cases.expect: Nothing is resent automatically; the conversation shows 'Interrupted. Nothing changed.' with a Try again control

cases.change: Vercel function crashes or is redeployed mid-request
cases.expect: Client receives a connection error and makes one automatic retry with the same requestId; the orphaned lease expires after 60 s; no second reservation

cases.change: Client offline
cases.expect: No request attempted; 'Can't reach atePDF AI. Nothing was sent.'; existing files, preview, export, Undo, deletion and settings keep working

cases.change: Request asks the relay to use a different model or endpoint (client-supplied field)
cases.expect: 400 unclassified_field; the relay chooses the model from server config only

cases.change: OPENAI_BASE_URL or any endpoint override present in the API environment
cases.expect: Relay refuses to start (pinned provider host), health check fails closed

cases.change: Per-request worst-case cost estimate above MAX_REQUEST_COST
cases.expect: 413 request_too_expensive before the provider call

cases.change: Anonymous sign-in burst from one network above the Supabase per-IP limit, or new installations above the global daily cap
cases.expect: Supabase Auth refuses further anonymous sign-ins (429); POST /v1/installations returns 429 registration_rate_limited above the global cap; atePDF stores no IP

cases.change: Guest installation links to an existing account
cases.expect: Link requires both the account token and the installation's anonymous session; consumed guest usage stays consumed; no new allowance (D-07); inst_A then acts as the account subject

cases.change: Provider end-user identifier
cases.expect: Provider request carries only safety_identifier = HMAC(PROVIDER_ID_SALT, subject); never installationId, subject, auth user ID, email, IP or device identifier

cases.change: Provider request body
cases.expect: Exactly: model gpt-6-luna; reasoning.effort none; developer message with the pinned prompt as one input_text block carrying prompt_cache_breakpoint {mode: explicit}; user message = context JSON after it; prompt_cache_options {mode: explicit, ttl: 30m}; store false; max_output_tokens 4000; three strict tools; no instructions, prompt_cache_retention, prompt_cache_key, metadata, previous_response_id or conversation

cases.change: Model config switched to a candidate that is not in the approved routing table
cases.expect: Relay refuses to start; approved models are an allowlist bound to the disclosure version

cases.change: Mac calls the Supabase Data API for any atePDF table with the publishable key or its own JWT
cases.expect: Denied: atePDF tables are in a schema not exposed to the Data API, RLS on, no anon/authenticated grants

cases.change: Relay database role attempts a direct SELECT/INSERT on any table
cases.expect: Permission denied; the role can only EXECUTE the named SECURITY DEFINER functions

cases.change: Canary: a synthetic instruction containing a unique marker string is planned end to end in staging
cases.expect: The marker is absent from Vercel runtime logs, Supabase API/Postgres/Auth logs, every Postgres table and the log line; present only in the mocked provider request

cases.change: Provider fixture reports usage.input_tokens_details.cache_write_tokens
cases.expect: cache_write_tokens never exceeds the fixed developer-prefix length; the user message is never written to the prompt cache
